title: Export valid percussion notes currently rejected by GP8
scope: Close missing native articulation mappings for valid percussion values found by the broad audit.
acceptance: Reproduce the rejected values in canon.gp5, full-song.gp5, nightwish.gp5 and upstream percussion-all.gp5.
Compare the source articulation, intended output MIDI and supported GP8 definition before adding a mapping.
Valid mappings preserve identity, notation and playback across all relevant staves/graces; unsupported values retain a precise rejection.
exclusions: Do not blanket-map arbitrary MIDI values to a convenient drum.
Conflicting staff line-count limits need separate representability evidence.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce the rejected values in canon.gp5, full-song.gp5, nightwish.gp5 and upstream percussion-all.gp5.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
